title: Maine Coastal Adventures

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Nothing compares to being out on the water as the last rays of sunlight go down at the end of a perfect summer day. Kick back, relax, and enjoy a scenic sunset cruise in the stern of our boat. Maybe you have a destination you’d like to visit, or maybe it is all about the journey. Either way, we’ll drive the boat, and you enjoy Maine as it should be experienced: on the water. Each 2-hour tour accommodates up to 6 people. Price is per group. All ages are welcome.
